# Font Awesome running icon

`person-running.svg` is the unmodified Font Awesome Free 6.7.2 solid icon by Fonticons, Inc., used for sports courses.

- Source: https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome/blob/6.x/svgs/solid/person-running.svg
- Icon license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
- Upstream license and attribution: `LICENSE.txt` and the SVG's retained comment.
